_meta.partial_definition: False means every registered geometry-layer cell is represented. It does not mean every cell carries an observation.
_meta.citation: Krishna, Ishan (2026). IGRM World State Matrix. https://igrm.in/data/world_state.json
_meta.what: Complete-country/area Atlas coverage matrix. Every registered geometry appears for every country-level layer; unavailable cells remain explicit. This is not a world risk score or a claim of complete measurement.

geometry_policy.member_definition: Every non-Antarctic country or area geometry in the bundled Natural Earth India-worldview artifact. This is a display denominator, not a diplomatic recognition list.
geometry_policy.partition_rule: Every geometry member must appear in every country-level layer as observed, unavailable, withheld, not_applicable or out_of_scope; absence is forbidden.
geometry_policy.territory_policy: Dependencies, disputed areas, leases and other mapped areas remain separate geometry members when the bundled source does so; the interface must not relabel them as sovereign states.
geometry_policy.display_rule: Every member renders. A missing analytical observation is rendered as missing, never removed from the map.

status_vocabulary.observed: A real value is present in the named published source payload.
status_vocabulary.unavailable_member_not_observed: The layer is published, but no observation exists for this member.
status_vocabulary.unavailable_layer_not_published: The layer is not yet a published observation layer for any member.

layers.label: India-partner event context
layers.construct: Counts and coded characteristics of GDELT event records linking India with a partner country or area.
layers.missingness_rule: No matching aggregate is unavailable, not zero.
layers.prohibited_interpretation: Not a census of events, bilateral tension score, probability, military condition, exposure or causal effect.
layers.safety_rule: No tactical location or individual movement is represented.

layers.label: Geopolitical tension
layers.construct: A future multi-lane measure separating diplomatic friction, coercive policy, mobilization and realized violence.
layers.missingness_rule: No country receives a tension value before the construct and benchmark are frozen.
layers.prohibited_interpretation: No probability of war, safety rating or universal risk score.
layers.safety_rule: Only country-period aggregates and delayed public evidence are eligible.

layers.label: Conflict and security events
layers.construct: Typed, dated conflict, political-violence, terrorism, coup, protest and security-event observations with source disagreement retained.
layers.missingness_rule: Provider non-coverage and observed zero are distinct states.
layers.prohibited_interpretation: No provider-coded event is ground truth and no event count is civilian safety.
layers.safety_rule: Public locations follow source terms and conflict-sensitive delay and aggregation rules.

layers.label: Economic state
layers.construct: Country macroeconomic capacity, external vulnerability and policy-space observations retained in original units.
layers.missingness_rule: Vintage, estimate status and revision history remain visible per indicator.
layers.prohibited_interpretation: No composite economic strength or crisis probability until separately registered and validated.

layers.label: Technology and AI capacity
layers.construct: Observable national AI, compute, semiconductor, research, talent, investment and digital-infrastructure capacity.
layers.missingness_rule: Unequal country measurement is exposed dimension by dimension; no imputation creates global coverage.
layers.prohibited_interpretation: No claim of intelligence, technological sovereignty or military AI capability from proxy counts.

layers.label: Defence resources
layers.construct: Military expenditure, burden, personnel and resourcing inputs with definitions and revisions preserved.
layers.missingness_rule: Official budget, broader military-expenditure estimate and missing value remain different states.
layers.prohibited_interpretation: Spending is an input and is not military capability, effectiveness or intent.

layers.label: Force and weapons inventory
layers.construct: Versioned public counts and attributes of major force elements and weapon-system classes.
layers.missingness_rule: Unknown, estimated, ordered, delivered, active, reserve and retired are separate statuses.
layers.prohibited_interpretation: Inventory count is not readiness, survivability, quality, combat power or battlefield outcome.
layers.safety_rule: No non-public specifications, vulnerabilities, precise current locations or operational tasking.

layers.label: Arms transfers and dependence
layers.construct: Supplier-recipient transfers, orders, deliveries and disclosed arms-export values with incompatible measures kept separate.
layers.missingness_rule: No report, zero transfer and incomplete disclosure are distinct; order and delivery are never conflated.
layers.prohibited_interpretation: SIPRI trend-indicator value is not price, expenditure or financial value.
layers.safety_rule: No shipment-level operational routing unless already public, rights-cleared and safely delayed.

layers.label: Military activity and posture
layers.construct: Publicly evidenced exercises, deployments, mobilization indicators, base activity, port calls and posture changes.
layers.missingness_rule: Not observed is never treated as not occurring; sensor and disclosure coverage travel with every observation.
layers.prohibited_interpretation: No omniscient live troop tracker, classified inference, targetable feed, exact readiness claim or prediction of attack.
layers.safety_rule: Aggregate and delay conflict-sensitive observations; refuse precise live tactical locations, individual tracks and operational vulnerabilities.

layers.label: Diplomacy, sanctions and coercive policy
layers.construct: Official diplomatic actions, sanctions, export controls, tariffs, treaty changes and other dated state-policy instruments.
layers.missingness_rule: Announcement, legal effect, implementation and expiry are separate temporal states.
layers.prohibited_interpretation: Policy presence is not enforcement, compliance, economic effect or hostility score.
layers.safety_rule: Public legal and diplomatic records only.

layers.label: Trade and supply-chain dependence
layers.construct: Country-product-route trade flows and concentration under exact reporter, partner, period and commodity denominators.
layers.missingness_rule: Reporter absence, partner absence, trade zero, confidentiality and late reporting are distinct.
layers.prohibited_interpretation: Trade association is not firm exposure, disruption, substitutability or economic loss.
layers.safety_rule: Public aggregates; shipment-level entities require explicit rights and privacy review.

layers.label: Energy and critical minerals
layers.construct: Production, reserves, refining, inventory, import dependence, route and infrastructure observations by energy or mineral unit.
layers.missingness_rule: Stock, flow, capacity, reserve and estimate units are never substituted for one another.
layers.prohibited_interpretation: Resource endowment is not available supply, resilience or political control.
layers.safety_rule: Public aggregate infrastructure and flow observations only.

layers.label: India exposure
layers.construct: Evidence-backed paths from external countries, commodities, firms, ports and policies into declared Indian sectors, states and critical assets.
layers.missingness_rule: Every declared universe partitions observed, missing, unmappable, stale and out-of-scope members.
layers.prohibited_interpretation: No edge may be inferred from co-mention and no path is impact, probability or causal effect.
layers.safety_rule: Sensitive critical-asset detail is aggregated or withheld under a registered publication policy.

layers.label: Resilience, response and recovery
layers.construct: Observed buffers, substitutions, policy responses, restoration, recovery time and unresolved consequence after a shock.
layers.missingness_rule: No observed recovery series means unresolved, not resilient or recovered.
layers.prohibited_interpretation: No universal resilience score or prescriptive advice without a registered decision context.
layers.safety_rule: Public aggregate response and recovery evidence only.

non_country_layers.label: Maritime and strategic logistics
non_country_layers.coverage_note: Current public coverage is four named waterways; every unmeasured port and corridor remains outside coverage.
